name: locale-fallback-p5
prompt: what should the UI show when a translation string is missing for the user's chosen language

chunks.content: added right-to-left layout support so Arabic mirrors the navigation correctly
set the column collation to be case-insensitive for username lookups
round displayed prices to the currency's minor unit so yen shows no decimals
preload the translation bundles into memory at boot
low TTL on the API record for fast regional failover
if a user hasn't set a timezone we default their displayed times to UTC rather than guessing
chart error rate per endpoint on the ops board
emails go through a durable outbox queue
export the invoice as a PDF attached to the billing email
gate the new onboarding tour behind a feature flag
decided that when a key is absent in the requested language we walk a fallback chain: try the regional variant, then the base language, then finally the default English copy
a missing string should never render an empty box or the raw key id to the user; we always fall back to a sensible default phrasing instead
untranslated keys hit at runtime are logged so the localization team gets a report of exactly which phrases still need a translation
a partially translated language still loads fine because each untranslated label individually borrows the base-language wording rather than blocking the whole page
regenerate the sitemap nightly so new product pages get indexed
record locale changes in the user activity log
